description: Source code for a test tool related to git submodules, including command implementations for checking submodule name, URL, active status, resolving relative URLs, and managing submodule configuration.

methods.name: check_submodule
methods.description: Applies a check function to each line of stdin, printing lines that pass the check.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_check_name
methods.description: Handles the 'check-name' subcommand to validate submodule names.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_check_url
methods.description: Handles the 'check-url' subcommand to validate submodule URLs.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_is_active
methods.description: Handles the 'is-active' subcommand to check if a submodule is active.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_resolve_relative_url
methods.description: Handles the 'resolve-relative-url' subcommand to resolve URLs relative to a given path.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_list
methods.description: Handles the 'config-list' subcommand to list submodule configuration.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_set
methods.description: Handles the 'config-set' subcommand to set submodule configuration.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_unset
methods.description: Handles the 'config-unset' subcommand to unset submodule configuration.

methods.name: cmd__submodule_config_writeable
methods.description: Handles the 'config-writeable' subcommand to check if submodule config is writable.

methods.name: cmd__submodule
methods.description: Main function to dispatch subcommands based on user input.
